result.content:
## Early life and education
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kelsey_Mann&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life and education")]
Mann graduated from [Burnsville High School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burnsville_High_School "Burnsville High School") in 1993. He went on to attend [Northern Michigan University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_Michigan_University "Northern Michigan University"), where he earned a [Bachelor of Fine Arts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor_of_Fine_Arts "Bachelor of Fine Arts") illustration in 1998.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-NMU-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-3)
## Career
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kelsey_Mann&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]
Mann started his career at [Cartoon Network](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cartoon_Network "Cartoon Network"), where he worked as a storyboard artist on _[Duck Dodgers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duck_Dodgers_\(TV_series\) "Duck Dodgers \(TV series\)")_ , _[Megas XLR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Megas_XLR "Megas XLR")_ , _[My Gym Partner's a Monkey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Gym_Partner's_a_Monkey "My Gym Partner's a Monkey")_ , _[Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foster's_Home_for_Imaginary_Friends "Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends")_ , and _[Star Wars: The Clone Wars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_The_Clone_Wars "Star Wars: The Clone Wars")_ , before joining [Pixar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pixar "Pixar") in 2009,[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-4) where he started as a story supervisor for _[Monsters University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monsters_University "Monsters University")_ , _[The Good Dinosaur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good_Dinosaur "The Good Dinosaur")_ (also co-wrote the story for the film), and _[Onward](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Onward_\(film\) "Onward \(film\)")_.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-6) He made his directorial debut with the short film _[Party Central](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Party_Central "Party Central")_ , which he also wrote, taking place shortly after _Monsters University_.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note

## 1986–1992: Development
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=History_of_Cartoon_Network&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: 1986–1992: Development")]
On March 25, 1986, [Ted Turner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ted_Turner "Ted Turner")'s [Turner Broadcasting System](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turner_Broadcasting_System "Turner Broadcasting System") acquired [Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer "Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer")/[United Artists](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Artists "United Artists") from [Kirk Kerkorian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirk_Kerkorian "Kirk Kerkorian"). However, due to concerns over the debt load of his companies, Turner was forced to sell MGM/UA back to Kerkorian on August 26, 1986, after just 75 days of ownership. However, Turner kept much of MGM's film and television library made before May 1986 (as well as some of the United Artists library) and both formed [Turner Entertainment Co.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turner_Entertainment_Co. "Turner Entertainment Co.") and created [Turner Network Television](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TNT_\(American_TV_network\) "TNT \(American TV network\)") from it.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Cartoon_Network#cite_note-a596-1) The pre-May 1986 MGM library also included animated shorts from United Artists' acquisition of [Associated Artists Productions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Associated_Artists_Productions "Associated Artists Productions"). In 1991, Turner acquired [Hanna-Barbera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanna-Barbera "Hanna-Barbera") for $320 million, outbidding [MCA Inc.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MCA_Inc. "MCA Inc.") ([Universal Studios](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Studios,_Inc. "Universal Studios, Inc.")) and [Hallmark Cards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hallmark_Cards "Hallmark Cards").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Cartoon_Network#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Cartoon_Network#cite_note-3)
